summary: Backend-only testing for SteelTrack. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_steeltrack_backend.py (with conftest.py loading EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env). Executed 25 tests covering auth (3 roles + bad creds + /auth/me), weight calc, inward creation (incl. variance flag, 0.5 pieces, unique sequential entry numbers), outward (broker required, inventory reduces correctly), inventory aggregation, entries list sorting + direction filter, GET by id, office PATCH RBAC (office/admin OK, labour 403), users admin RBAC (admin OK, office/labour 403), register user by admin + login, and upload + authenticated file retrieval via object storage. All 25/25 passed on public URL https://weight-check-30.preview.emergentagent.com. Entry numbers verified in format INW-YYYYMMDD-NNNN with sequential increments. Theoretical weight for 10x1250x2500x1 = 245.3125 kg confirmed. Variance threshold 0.2% behaves correctly (1226.5 vs 1226.5625 => not flagged; 1500 => flagged).

minor.issue: Returns 403 when Authorization header is missing (HTTPBearer auto_error=False + manual check). Spec commonly expects 401; functional impact negligible.

No stock-availability check: an outward entry can be created for a size/grade with no corresponding inward stock, causing negative pieces_available (filtered out from /api/inventory). Consider validating against current stock or requiring source_entry_id.

action_items: (Optional) Return 401 instead of 403 when Authorization header is missing on protected endpoints for consistency with HTTP semantics.
(Optional) Add stock validation on POST /api/entries/outward to prevent outward entries exceeding available inventory (or make source_entry_id mandatory and decrement from it).
No critical fixes required — all 16 feature points in the review request are working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~580 lines — still manageable but approaching the recommended split threshold; consider separating routes (auth/entries/inventory/upload) into modules if more features are added.
Uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup')/@app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager.
Global mutable `storage_key` is modified without a lock; under high concurrency this could race, but current retry-on-503 logic mitigates the practical impact.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed users (test_user_<ts>@steeltrack.com) and several inward/outward entries. No cleanup performed (safe for isolated preview DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Seeded users: admin/office/labour @steeltrack.com with passwords admin123/office123/labour123. Entry numbers format: INW|OUT-YYYYMMDD-NNNN, sequential per prefix+date (counters collection). Weight formula: t*w*l*p*7.85e-6 (kg). Variance threshold 0.2%. Upload uses Emergent object storage via INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL/EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; files retrievable at /api/files/{path} with Bearer token (labour can only read own uploads).
rca_of_issue: No bugs encountered during this test run.
